#!/usr/bin/env python3
"""Whole-file limit tests plus maximum-workload performance."""
import json, os, subprocess, sys, time, resource

SUB = "/app/submission/ipv6_replay.py"
WORK = "/workspace/scratch/work3"
os.makedirs(WORK, exist_ok=True)
fails = []

def write(name, data):
    p = os.path.join(WORK, name)
    mode = "wb" if isinstance(data, (bytes, bytearray)) else "w"
    open(p, mode).write(data)
    return p

def check(label, cond, extra=""):
    if not cond:
        fails.append(label); print("FAIL[%s] %s" % (label, extra))

MAN = {"version":1,"seed":1,"low_count":2,"attempts":2,"spacing_ms":10,"timeout_ms":100,
       "windows":[{"id":"w","start_ms":0,"scopes":[{"id":"s","prefix":"2001:db8:1::/64","subnets":[0]}]}]}
mp = write("m.json", json.dumps(MAN))

def expect2(label, args):
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, SUB] + args, capture_output=True, timeout=300)
    check(label, p.returncode == 2 and not p.stdout and p.stderr.strip(),
          "rc=%s out=%r err=%r" % (p.returncode, p.stdout[:100], p.stderr[:200]))

# file larger than 96 MiB
big = os.path.join(WORK, "big.jsonl")
with open(big, "wb") as fh:
    fh.truncate(96 * 1024 * 1024 + 1)
expect2("log > 96MiB", ["replay", mp, big])
os.remove(big)

# exactly 96 MiB is allowed (size ok, content junk -> quarantine)
big2 = os.path.join(WORK, "big2.jsonl")
with open(big2, "wb") as fh:
    fh.truncate(96 * 1024 * 1024)
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, SUB, "replay", mp, big2], capture_output=True, timeout=300)
check("log == 96MiB", p.returncode == 0 and b'"reason":"json"' in p.stdout,
      "rc=%s err=%r" % (p.returncode, p.stderr[:200]))
os.remove(big2)

# more than 300000 physical lines
rp = write("many.jsonl", "{}\n" * 300001)
expect2("log > 300000 lines", ["replay", mp, rp])

# exactly 300000 lines is fine
rp = write("many2.jsonl", "{}\n" * 300000)
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, SUB, "replay", mp, rp], capture_output=True, timeout=300)
check("log == 300000 lines", p.returncode == 0, "rc=%s err=%r" % (p.returncode, p.stderr[:200]))

# a physical line longer than 4096 bytes
rp = write("long.jsonl", "x" * 4096 + "\n")
expect2("line 4097 bytes", ["replay", mp, rp])
# exactly 4096 bytes including LF is allowed (quarantined as json)
rp = write("long2.jsonl", "x" * 4095 + "\n")
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, SUB, "replay", mp, rp], capture_output=True, timeout=300)
check("line 4096 bytes", p.returncode == 0 and b'"reason":"json"' in p.stdout,
      "rc=%s err=%r" % (p.returncode, p.stderr[:200]))
# 4096 bytes without LF at EOF is allowed too
rp = write("long3.jsonl", "x" * 4096)
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, SUB, "replay", mp, rp], capture_output=True, timeout=300)
check("line 4096 bytes no LF", p.returncode == 0, "rc=%s err=%r" % (p.returncode, p.stderr[:200]))
# 4097 bytes without LF at EOF -> error
rp = write("long4.jsonl", "x" * 4097)
expect2("line 4097 bytes no LF", ["replay", mp, rp])

# no trailing newline still counts the last row
rp = write("nonl.jsonl", "x")
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, SUB, "replay", mp, rp], capture_output=True, timeout=300)
check("no trailing LF", p.returncode == 0 and json.loads(p.stdout)["diagnostics"] == [{"line":1,"reason":"json"}],
      p.stdout[:200])

# CRLF
rp = write("crlf.jsonl", '{"probe_id":"w/s/0/low-1/0","received_ms":0,"target":"2001:db8:1::1","source":"2001:db8:1::1","type":129,"code":0}\r\n')
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, SUB, "replay", mp, rp], capture_output=True, timeout=300)
check("crlf", p.returncode == 0 and json.loads(p.stdout)["accepted_rows"] == 1,
      "rc=%s out=%r err=%r" % (p.returncode, p.stdout[:200], p.stderr[:200]))

# ---- maximum workload ----
maxman = {"version":1,"seed":123456789,"low_count":32,"attempts":3,"spacing_ms":1,"timeout_ms":1000,
          "windows":[{"id":"w%d" % i,"start_ms":1000*i,"scopes":[
              {"id":"s%d" % j,"prefix":"2001:db8:%x:%x00::/56" % (i, j),"subnets":list(range(0,256,32))}
              for j in range(8)]} for i in range(8)]}
assert sum(len(s["subnets"]) for w in maxman["windows"] for s in w["scopes"]) == 2048
mp2 = write("max.json", json.dumps(maxman))
t0 = time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, SUB, "plan", mp2], capture_output=True, timeout=300)
t1 = time.time()
check("max plan rc", p.returncode == 0, "rc=%s err=%r" % (p.returncode, p.stderr[:300]))
data = json.loads(p.stdout)
check("max probe count", len(data["probes"]) == 208896, str(len(data["probes"])))
print("max plan: %.1fs, stdout %d bytes" % (t1 - t0, len(p.stdout)))

# max replay: 300000 rows
rows = []
for i in range(300000):
    rows.append(json.dumps({"probe_id":"w0/s0/%d/low-1/0" % ((i//34) % 8),"received_ms":0,
                            "target":"2001:db8:0:0::1","source":"2001:db8:0:0::1","type":129,"code":0}))
rp2 = write("max.jsonl", "\n".join(rows) + "\n")
t0 = time.time()
p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, SUB, "replay", mp2, rp2], capture_output=True, timeout=300)
t1 = time.time()
check("max replay rc", p.returncode == 0, "rc=%s err=%r" % (p.returncode, p.stderr[:300]))
if p.returncode == 0:
    r = json.loads(p.stdout)
    check("max replay accepted", r["accepted_rows"] == 300000, str(r["accepted_rows"]))
    check("max replay segs", len(r["segments"]) == 2048, str(len(r["segments"])))
print("max replay: %.1fs, stdout %d bytes" % (t1 - t0, len(p.stdout)))

print("limit failures:", len(fails), fails)
PYEOF
cd /workspace/scratch && python3 t_limits.py
